text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — we're hitting EBS attach + IOPS limits in us-west-2 for the GPU cluster. Several training jobs failing during checkpointing. Need quota increases: gp3 IOPS per volume -> 16000, throughput -> 1000 MB/s, snapshot concurrency -> 50, volumes per region -> 12000. Also ENI/Private IP and GPU instance quotas (p4d/g5). AWS account 123456789012. Can someone open requests?
Samir Patel: Noted. Which jobs are failing, any quick error snippets?
Alex Chen: Mostly kubelet attach errors: "attachVolume: volume attachment limit exceeded" and occasional `i/o timeout` during heavy writes. Example log: ```kubectl logs gpu-node-12 | grep attach
E0421 11:02:37 kubelet.go:1234] attach failed: rpc error: code=Internal desc="volume attachment limit exceeded"```
Katie Nguyen: @Alex can you paste current quotas and target numbers so I can file with AWS?
Alex Chen: Current gp3 default IOPS 3000, throughput 125 MB/s; target: IOPS 16000, throughput 1000 MB/s. Snapshot concurrent ops default 10 -> request 50. Volumes per region currently 5000 -> request 12000. ENI limit 350 -> request 700 (we plan ~200 GPU nodes). p4d quota currently 0 -> request 8, g5 currently 10 -> request 40. Region: us-west-2. Tagging request as cost center: ml-inference.
devops-bot: Created AWS support case #1012345671 for EBS/I/O increases. ETA: 48-72h. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1012345671 
SRE Lead: We should also explicitly request increases for "Network Interfaces" and "Private IPs per ENI" — otherwise attachments and pod networking fail even if EBS limits are lifted. @Katie please add those to the ticket. Also propose temporary mitigations: reduce checkpoint parallelism, enable incremental snapshotting, and shift some non-urgent runs to us-east-1 to reduce immediate pressure.
Katie Nguyen: Adding those now. I'll request ENI -> 700, Private IPs per ENI -> 10, and confirm ENA driver images for GPU nodes. Filing cases for compute quotas as well.
Samir Patel: What's the cost impact if we get full capacity? Need a number for finance and approvals.
Alex Chen: Rough estimate if fully utilized: 8 p4d nodes ~= $80k/month (on-demand); g5 fleet at scale ~ $30k/month. We won't provision all nodes at once — autoscale + budget alerts. I'll prepare a short cost justification.
finance-bot: Finance noted. Please fill the internal form at https://internal.redwood/finance/quotas with the monthly estimate and justification tag ml-inference.
SRE Lead: Plan: (1) Katie files the cases for EBS/ENI/compute, (2) reduce checkpoint parallelism and enable incremental snapshots immediately, (3) test under the new limits with a 4-node canary once AWS confirms, (4) scale gradually to target. If AWS is slow, I'll schedule a TAM call.
Katie Nguyen: Filed additional cases: #1012345672 (ENI / Private IP) and #1012345673 (p4d/g5 capacity). Links: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1012345672 and https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1012345673. I'll post updates here as they arrive.
Samir Patel: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: @Katie (AWS cases), @SRE Lead (test plan), @Alex (logs + migration steps).
Alex Chen: Thanks team — I'll start throttling checkpoint concurrency and post before/after metrics. :thumbsup:
